bagPolicy.summary: Camp Randall Stadium enforces a clear bag policy to enhance security. Only specific types of bags are allowed, and all other items are prohibited.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Camp Randall Stadium Parking offers convenient parking services for visitors, located at 1595 Engineering Dr. It provides a hassle-free parking experience for events and games, with operating hours from 9 am to 6 pm on weekdays.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Camp Randall Stadium's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at Camp Randall Stadium varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Camp Randall Stadium, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Camp Randall Stadium's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Camp Randall Stadium. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Camp Randall Stadium. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
